steps.en: Register the Stitch MCP server with its env vars and credentials
steps.zh: 按 setup 文档注册 Stitch MCP server，配好环境变量和凭证

steps.en: Install the plugin suite into your agent
The agent gains Stitch verbs as loadable skills
steps.zh: agent 由此获得驱动 Stitch 的技能

steps.en: Describe the screen you want, as usual
The skill turns it into Stitch calls and generates screens in your project
steps.zh: skill 把它翻译成 Stitch 调用，在你的项目里生成屏幕

steps.en: Once happy, ask to convert the screens to components
steps.zh: 满意后，让它把屏幕转成组件

steps.en: Exports a React component system, running its validation scripts before handing you code
steps.zh: 导出 React 组件体系，先跑自带校验脚本再交代码

value.en: The brainstorm-to-components loop runs inside your agent — no hand-carrying HTML between the Stitch web UI and your codebase
value.zh: 从构思到组件的闭环在 agent 里跑完——不用再在 Stitch 网页端和代码库之间人肉搬运 HTML

sources: README.md 'Prerequisites': register the server and set up appropriate environment variables and credentials (Stitch MCP Setup Instructions)
README.md 'Claude Code & Cursor': npx plugins add google-labs-code/stitch-skills --scope project --target claude-code
README.md 'Available Plugins' tables: stitch::generate-design, stitch::react-components; plugin groups stitch-design / stitch-build / stitch-utilities
README.md skill descriptions: 'Generate new screens from text or images'; 'Convert Stitch screens to React component systems with automated validation and design token consistency'
README.md 'Repository Structure': each skill ships scripts/ (Executable enforcers: Validation & Networking)
